The '''Narg system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

It was six hours' travel from the [[Laim system/Legends|Laim system]] with a standard [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="WEGTA">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
